heuristics: Random-mapping model for the 20-adding walk: collision waiting time and distinguished-point count obey the birthday bound used in proof.md. Teske's r-adding experiments support the model at small orders; the production extrapolation is disclosed there.
limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution or independent qualification.
Success probability 0.5 is conditional on the stated random-mapping heuristic, not on a worst-case theorem.
Generic group walk, not a finite-field index-calculus estimate.
Astronomical distinguished-point storage is charged and reported; it is not practical.
